hooks.command: f=$(node -e "const j=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(0,'utf8'));process.stdout.write((j.tool_input&&j.tool_input.file_path)||(j.tool_response&&j.tool_response.filePath)||'')"); case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.astro|*.jsx|*.js) out=$(npx eslint --fix "$f" 2>&1) || { echo "$out" >&2; exit 2; } ;; esac

f=$(node -e "const j=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(0,'utf8'));process.stdout.write((j.tool_input&&j.tool_input.file_path)||(j.tool_response&&j.tool_response.filePath)||'')"); case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.astro) out=$(npx astro check 2>&1) || { printf '%s\n' "$out" | tail -60 >&2; exit 2; } ;; esac

f=$(node -e "const j=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(0,'utf8'));const p=(j.tool_input&&j.tool_input.file_path)||(j.tool_response&&j.tool_response.filePath)||'';process.stdout.write(p.split(String.fromCharCode(92)).join('/'))"); case "$f" in */src/middleware.ts|*/src/lib/*|*/src/pages/api/*) out=$(AI_AGENT=1 npx vitest related "$f" --run 2>&1) || { echo "$out" | tail -40 >&2; exit 2; } ;; esac
hooks.statusMessage: Testy powiązane z edytowanym plikiem (vitest related)...
